title: Cavity shape reconstruction with a homogeneous Robin condition via a constrained coupled complex boundary method with ADMM
summary: We revisit the problem of identifying an unknown portion of a boundary subject to a Robin condition based on a pair of Cauchy data on the accessible part of the boundary. It is known that a single measurement may correspond to infinitely many admissible domains. Nonetheless, numerical strategies based on shape optimization have been shown to yield reasonable reconstructions of the unknown boundary.
